title: Sachin
desc: A boy is named after Sachin Tendulkar, as his birth coincides with a celebratory day. As he grows older and falls for a woman named Anjali, he finds that they have a lot more in common than usual.

title: Pudhu Nellu Pudhu Nathu
desc: An old widow returns to her village with her two sons. The elder son is an illiterate peasant, the younger an educated, urbane youth, who falls in love with an iron-fisted local landlord's daughter.

title: Azhagiya Theye
desc: Nandhini asks Chandran to sabotage her forced marriage to an NRI. However, Chandran's scheme backfires, leading their lives to take a surprising turn.

title: Captain Magal
desc: Kavitha and Kalyan, a married couple, go to a hill station on a vacation. But their peace is shattered when strange things begin happening at the guest house they are staying in.

title: Ulavuthurai
desc: Vasanth Periyasamy, a naval officer, is assigned to investigate the mysterious deaths at the sea. To protect his family, he assumes the identity of a car driver.
